About the template

A motion-first system for premium landing pages.

Pulse Studio is structured around reusable sections, shared animation helpers, and expressive visual modules that can scale from a one-page launch to a full product site.

Principles

Motion should support the story, not fight it.

Clarity

Every section has a clear role, readable hierarchy, and focused call to action.

Pace

Entrance and scroll animations are timed to make the page feel guided and responsive.

Reuse

Shared classes and helper functions make new pages fast to assemble.

Team shape

Designed for designers, marketers, and frontend teams.

Design Ready

Strong visual modules, polished spacing, and a flexible dark interface.

Dev Friendly

Small files, semantic markup, and modular GSAP utilities.

Launch Focused

Sections for proof, process, features, pricing, and conversion.
